questions.question: How do I receive my ticket after a successful payment?
questions.answer: An electronic ticket (QR Code) will be sent automatically via the Email and phone number (Zalo/SMS) you registered, within 1-3 minutes after the system confirms your payment.

questions.question: Can I exchange or refund a ticket I've purchased?
questions.answer: Exchange and refund policies depend on each attraction's specific rules. Please check the "Ticket Conditions" section carefully before payment, or contact our Hotline for further assistance.

questions.question: Do agents need to commit to a monthly sales target?
questions.answer: We offer multiple agent tiers, from a free affiliate with no sales target to a diamond-level agent. Leave your details on the registration form and our team will advise the right plan for you.
